entries.title: Magigoo PP 50 mL external reference
entries.source_scope: DREMC Magigoo PP 50 mL retailer identity/SKU versus current Magigoo PP page using Glide PP wording. Current family application guidance is conditional; exact legacy bottle/formula mapping, grade and plate compatibility remain unverified.

facts.value: Captured DREMC reference: Magigoo PP 50 mL, retailer SKU 5350583999921. This code is not established as an official manufacturer MPN.
Current official PP page describes an adhesive for polypropylene and PP composites. It does not establish suitability for every filled grade or for PLA/PETG/nylon.
Current family guidance says to activate the nib on a cold build plate and spread a thin, even stripe; transfer of that procedure to the exact retailer bottle revision is unverified.

proofs.quote: Press the nib against the cold build plate
Spread one thin stripe back and forth

facts.value: Current family guidance says to let the bed cool completely before removal. This is not a guaranteed release time or damage-free promise for an unspecified plate.
DREMC warns that using this PP adhesive with non-PP filaments may cause excessive adhesion and damage the build surface; retain this as a scoped retailer caution.

proofs.quote: Using this product with other than PP type filaments might cause over adhesion and damage your build surface.

facts.value: DREMC listing captured 13 October 2026: AUD39.95 including GST, shipping calculated separately. Dated external reference only, not a live 3D Byte Tech offer, stock or delivery confirmation.

guides.value: Choose this adhesive by its PP material scope rather than the Magigoo brand alone. The captured DREMC bottle is 50 mL; the current manufacturer page uses Glide PP wording and describes thin application on a cold plate followed by cooling before removal. The listing warns that non-PP use may over-adhere and damage a plate. Confirm the exact bottle revision, filament grade and plate combination; the references do not prove compatibility with the legacy Fiberlogy 750 g spool or a damage-free release.

proofs.quote: Press the nib against the cold build plate
Using this product with other than PP type filaments might cause over adhesion and damage your build surface.

entries.title: Micro Swiss FlowTech CM2 M2904-04 0.4 mm nozzle
entries.source_scope: Exact 0.4 mm M2904-04 FlowTech CM2 variant matched in official and DREMC JSON. Manufacturer nozzle-only temperature rating and listed FlowTech hotend fit do not rate an entire printer, other nozzle interfaces or every abrasive grade.

facts.value: M2904-04 is the official 0.4 mm FlowTech CM2 variant, also matched by the captured AU listing.
Manufacturer describes a Copper Chromium Zirconium nozzle body with electroless nickel plating.

proofs.quote: Plated with an Electroless Nickel Plating

facts.value: Manufacturer describes an M2 hardened high-speed-steel insert; this is a different nozzle construction from the current official M3101 package’s brass-plated default nozzle.

proofs.quote: M2 Hardened High Speed Steel insert

facts.value: The manufacturer lists a 450°C maximum for this nozzle family only. It does not establish a 450°C hotend, thermistor, printer or filament rating.
The official CM2 FlowTech fit list includes the M3101 FlowTech hotend for K1 / K1 Max / K1C; this does not establish fit in the original stock K1 hotend or V6/Revo/Unicorn interfaces.

proofs.quote: FlowTech™ Hotend for Creality K1 / K1 Max / K1C (M3101)

facts.value: DREMC listing captured 13 October 2026: AUD44.45 including GST, shipping calculated separately. Dated external reference only, not a live 3D Byte Tech offer, stock or delivery confirmation.

guides.value: Select the exact M2904-04 0.4 mm FlowTech CM2 variant by its opening and proprietary hotend fit. Its hardened M2 insert differs from the hotend’s default brass-plated nozzle. The nozzle’s listed 450°C maximum does not raise the M3101 hotend’s manufacturer 300°C limit. Keep original-stock K1, V6/Revo/Unicorn interchangeability and every-material abrasive suitability unresolved. Other CM2 diameters and CHT versions require separate identity binding.

proofs.quote: M2 Hardened High Speed Steel insert
FlowTech™ Hotend for Creality K1 / K1 Max / K1C (M3101)
